div.div:
Keycloak owns credentials / password hashes and its separate identity DB.
Accounts owns business eligibility and merchant approval.
Roles here are profile mappings; JWT role checks plus domain ownership apply.
No passwords or Google tokens in these application tables.

text.tspan: Keycloak owns credentials / password hashes and its separate identity DB.
Accounts owns business eligibility and merchant approval.
Roles here are profile mappings; JWT role checks plus domain ownership apply.
No passwords or Google tokens in these application tables.

div.div:
Zone granularity and actual rates must be agreed with the lecturer / business.
Booking validates an unexpired quote and copies its immutable price snapshot.
Delivery never updates Pricing tables; later rate changes do not alter old fees.
Merchant key hash / scopes may be normalized to a credential table in implementation.
